BOX 18.6  CLINICAL APPLICATIONS
High- and Low-Potassium Food Guide
What foods are high in potassium (greater than 
200 milligrams per portion)?
The following table lists foods that are high in potassium.
The portion size is 1⁄
1 2⁄ cup unless otherwise stated. Please
be sure to check portion sizes. While all the foods on
this list are high in potassium, some are higher than others.
High-Potassium Foods
What foods are low in potassium?
The following table list foods that are low in potassium. A
portion is 1⁄
1 2⁄ cup unless otherwise noted. Eating more
than 1 portion can make a lower-potassium food into
a higher-potassium food.
Low-Potassium Foods
How do I get some of the potassium out of my 
favorite high-potassium vegetables?
The process of leaching will help pull potassium out of
some high-potassium vegetables. It is important to remem-
ber that leaching will not pull all of the potassium out of
the vegetable. You must still limit the amount of leached
high-potassium vegetables you eat. Ask your dietitian about
the amount of leached vegetables that you can safely have
in your diet.
